title: English teacher
description:
Nova oportunidade para English teacher em rio branco. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you! Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good Wi Fi, a webcam, and a microphone.If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach! Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at Latin Hire? You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts. If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out. When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with Latin Hire:Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week! You be your own boss and set your own schedule Work from anywhere (as long as you have good Wi Fi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone). Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.Minimum Requirements:Portuguese as a first language. C1 or C2 Level English Speaker University degree in English Teaching or related area. One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language. Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2 MB) internet connection. Must pass a criminal background check. Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.

*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO NEFROLOGISTA NA TELADOC HEALTH\"Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos e Médicas Especialistas emNefrologia!Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH:* A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.*O QUE PROCURAMOS:*Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade deNefrologia, de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos.*PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES*Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Nefrologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios nefrológicos.Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anmneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em Nefrologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.Habilidade em conduzir entrevistas detalhadas e observar sintomas e sinais da especialidade Nefrologia através de videochamadas.Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças nefrológicas.Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde em Nefrologia.Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.Manter-se bem informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.REQUISITOSFormação Acadêmica: Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA CONCLUÍDA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO/PÓS EM NEFROLOGIA.Certificações: Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM); Certificado de Título de Especialista em Nefrologia - RQE(Emitido pelo Conselho do respectivo Estado); Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil);Experiência: Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Nefrologia, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina.Conhecimentos Específicos para a função: Competência em prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios nefrológicos.Competências Comportamentais: Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.Outros Requisitos Importantes: Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. title: Senior revops analyst - churn
description:
Empresa está contratando Senior revops analyst - churn em manaus. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Contract Type:Fixed-Term Contract (Maternity Leave Cover) Duration:6 months initially, with potential extension to 9 months.About the Role We are seekinga Senior Rev Ops Analyst - Churnto join our Customer organisation. Reporting to the Rev Ops Senior Manager - Customer, this role will lead the reporting, analysis, and process evolution of churn performance as the business scales across multiple business units. This is a highly visible analytical role responsible for ensuring customer churn, revenue impact, retention activity, and related operational metrics are reported accurately, consistently, and with clear business insight. You will partner closely with Renewals, Customer Success, Finance, Rev Ops, and senior leadership to turn churn data into actionable commentary and decisions. The role will strengthen Salesforce and related reporting processes as reliable systems of record, while continuously improving the cadence, quality, and efficiency of churn reporting across the organisation.Key Responsibilities Churn Reporting & Revenue Impact Own reporting of customer churn and associated revenue impact across all business units. Ensure accuracy across multiple methodologies, reconcile results where required, and translate the numbers into a clear story that can be understood and acted on by senior leaders. Retention Analysis & Insight Analyse the customer(churn pipeline and build reporting that delivers insight into retention initiatives, discount usage, save rates, customer contact rates, customer health status, and other leading or lagging indicators of churn risk. Process Standardisation & Continuous Improvement Drive standardisation and evolution of churn reporting processes as systems, definitions, and business processes mature. Proactively identify opportunities to improve the reporting cycle, increase efficiency, reduce manual effort, and enhance the quality of insight month over month. Salesforce Data Quality & Governance Strengthen Salesforce as a system of record by validating data, identifying reporting exceptions, and partnering with Renewals, Rev Ops, Finance, and Revenue Technology stakeholders to ensure dashboards are accurate and items that are not true churn are not reported as churn. Monthly Business Review Preparation & Presentation Prepare materials, briefing documents, and commentary for monthly business reviews. Deep dive into reported numbers, explain key movements and drivers, present insights to senior leaders including the CFO and CCO, respond to queries, track actions, and evolve the reporting process.Required Qualifications & Experience Technical & Operational Expertise Strong experience in an analytical, finance, revenue operations, customer operations, or similar data-driven role. Bachelor's degree minimum, ideally in Economics, Finance, Business, Data Analytics, or a related field. Strong working knowledge of Salesforce, particularly opportunity management, renewal and churn data, reporting structures, and data flows that impact customer and revenue reporting. High proficiency in Excel, with the ability to manage complex calculations, reconcile datasets, investigate variances, and build structured reporting outputs. Experience with BI or reporting tools such as Power BI is advantageous. Revenue & Churn Acumen Experience working with finance and revenue data, including the concepts of annual recurring revenue (ARR) and contracted annual recurring revenue (CARR) in a subscription or Saa S business. Ability to connect churn revenue metrics to retention activity, customer health indicators, and operational performance metrics. Strong analytical judgement, with the ability to double click into results, identify root causes, and explain whether movements are driven by data quality, process, customer behaviour, commercial actions, or broader business trends. Understanding of customer lifecycle, renewals, retention, and churn management processes is highly desirable. Leadership & Stakeholder Management Competent and confident presenting to, influencing, and constructively challenging senior stakeholders. Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience working across multiple stakeholders in a global organisation. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to turn complex data into clear insight, concise commentary, and practical recommendations. Proactive, curious, and comfortable operating in an evolving environment where processes, systems, and definitions continue to mature.

Who are we?Transcenda, headquartered in the US, was founded in July 2019 and is a full-lifecycle product development company. With locations throughout Romania, Poland, Ukraine, and Brazil, Transcenda works with Fortune 500 companies and well-funded startups to help bring new products to life. Transcenda helps companies ideate new product concepts, build prototypes, design world-class solutions then engineer new commercial products. Transcenda puts people first and strives to be a changemaker by building a better world through technology. Transcenda has grown from a 5-person team to over 250 people over the past four years and plans to continue growing. About the role This is a senior, consultancy-style design role. You'll move between leading projects end-to-end — driving discovery, aligning stakeholders, shaping direction — and rolling up your sleeves as a senior-level individual contributor when that's what the work needs. You'll be working on mature, live products where the bar is improving what exists: smoothing workflows, sharpening hierarchy, lifting conversion, and removing friction. This is not a greenfield, portfolio-piece role. If you get satisfaction from making a working product noticeably better for the people who use it every day, you'll like it here. Key responsibilities Take ownership of design problems on assigned projects — frame the problem, drive it through discovery, design, and delivery, and bring stakeholders along the whole way. Lead or contribute on a project depending on what's needed — sometimes you're directing the design effort, sometimes you're the one in Figma producing the work. Both modes should feel comfortable. Partner closely with product managers and engineers, translating ambiguous requirements into concrete, testable design solutions and iterating against live implementations. Run the iterative cycle from low-fidelity exploration through high-fidelity delivery, with usability validation at the points where it actually changes the outcome. Facilitate workshops, design reviews, and working sessions with cross-functional and executive stakeholders. Make decisions visible and trade-offs explicit. Mentor and raise the bar for designers around you. Build durable relationships with stakeholders. Understand what they're actually trying to achieve and push back constructively when the brief is wrong. Must haves 6–10+ years of UX/Product Design experience, ideally including time in a consultancy, agency, or embedded-team setting where you've owned client or stakeholder relationships directly. Demonstrated ability to flex between leading a project (or a small team) and contributing as a senior IC, depending on what the engagement needs. Track record of improving existing products rather than designing greenfield experiences — measurable wins on usability, conversion, or workflow efficiency. Strong visual and UI judgment for forms, workflows, CTAs, hierarchy, and layout. You can defend a layout decision on the merits. Comfort working closely with engineering against live implementations — you can read a real interface and tell us what's wrong with it before opening Figma. Ability to articulate why a design decision was made and what problem it solves, to audiences ranging from engineers to executives. Experience facilitating cross-functional workshops and leading business reviews or strategic planning sessions with senior stakeholders. Nice to have Background designing for regulated or enterprise domains (finance, compliance, GRC, banking, or similar). Experience designing software embedded inside third-party platforms. Familiarity with mature component libraries and design systems (MUI or similar). Experience mentoring or leveling up other designers through example and critique. Working knowledge of HTML/CSS; Java Script a plus. Degree in Design, HCI, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent experience.

Proactively identify opportunities to improve the reporting cycle, increase efficiency, reduce manual effort, and enhance the quality of insight month over month. title: Regional study director, latam
description:

Crinetics is a pharmaceutical company headquartered in San Diego, California, with a growing presence in Latin America, including an office in Brazil. We are developing much-needed therapies for people with endocrine diseases and endocrine-related tumors. We were founded by a dedicated team of scientists with the simple belief that better therapies developed from rigorous innovation can lead to better lives. The Regional Study Director, LATAM is responsible for managing the execution of clinical studies and data collection within the LATAM region. The incumbent will serve as a regional clinical study lead who oversees the review, monitoring, and adherence to clinical protocols, as well as managing and building relationships with clinical sites in LATAM. The Regional Study Director, LATAM may oversee other regional study leads within the region to facilitate a streamlined and quality study execution. This role will also work internally and externally with members of the cross-functional study team.Essential Job Functions and Responsibilities: These may include but are not limited to: Provide oversight of clinical research studies for LATAM. Manage and build relationships with clinical research sites in LATAM. May oversee the work of other regional study leads within LATAM. Provide operational and strategic input into study documents such as synopsis, protocol, ICF, CRFs, CRF Completion Guidelines, Study Execution Plans, Clinical Data Review Plan, Clinical Database edit specifications, Clinical Study Report (CSR) development, etc. Oversight of all regional vendors and activities including CROs. Oversee regional start up activities including site selection, enrollment projections and activities driving site activation. Develop region specific the subject recruitment/retention strategy and related initiatives. Oversight of regional TMF ongoing quality review, and final reconciliation of study documents including review of site regulatory documents/packages and obtaining of appropriate site insurance, and/or supervision of team members performing these activities. Development of training materials for study team, investigational sites, and vendors. Proactive management of information sharing with key stakeholders using standardized reports and other mechanisms. Assure clinical studies are compliant with GDPR, ICH/GCP and other regulations as appropriate. Outline regional activation hurdles for team. Participate in RFP development and prepare bid templates to facilitate selection of the CROs/vendors, and/or collaboration/supervision with team members performing these activities. Collaborate with counsel to negotiate and draft research contracts and agreements with CROs/vendors and clinical study sites, as needed. Acts as liaison with Regulatory Affairs to assure adherence to GDPR, GCPs; maintenance of SOPs; and assure site and CRO/vendor audits are completed. Perform regional risk management and implement mitigations. Identify potential study issues and recommend and implement solutions or corrective actions as needed. Create realistic plans that clearly define goals, milestones, responsibilities, and results. Maintain focus on strategic objectives while accomplishing operational goals. Make timely, data-driven decisions. Manage daily activities, assign tasks, goals, and development of direct reports. Other duties as assigned.Required Education and Experience: Bachelor’s degree required, preferably in scientific discipline. An equivalent combination of relevant education and applicable job experience may be considered. 12 years of prior clinical operations experience preferably with CRO/small biotech experience and approximately 8 years of experience in a supervisory role. Must be able to travel 25-50% of time, may be higher in accordance with project requirements. Computer skills should include proficiency with Microsoft Office suite of software, electronic TMF systems, IXRS and EDC systems. Excellent understanding of drug development process. Experience in clinical trial supply management. Able to make appropriate decisions to move the project(s) forward. Effective verbal and written communication skills. Data flow from sites to data processing, review, and resolution. Analysis and report generation. Knowledge of local regulatory requirements. Ability to handle multiple tasks to meet deadlines in a dynamic environment is essential. Study initiation procedures. Ability to exercise judgment and determine appropriate action

About Yipit Data: Yipit Data is the market-leading data and analytics firm. We analyze billions of data points every day to provide accurate, detailed insights across industries, including consumer brands, technology, software, and healthcare. Our insights team uses proprietary technology to identify, license, clean, and analyze the data that many of the world’s largest investment funds and corporations depend on. We raised $475 M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation over $1 B, further accelerating our growth and market impact. We have been recognized multiple times as one of Inc’s Best Workplaces. As a fast-growing company backed by The Carlyle Group and Norwest Venture Partners, Yipit Data is driven by a people-first culture rooted in mastery, ownership, and transparency. With offices in New York, Austin, Miami, Denver, Mountain View, Seattle, Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, and Singapore, we continue to expand our reach and impact across global markets.About the Role: We currently have 60+ Data team members in our Investor business who build, create and maintain our data products, and we are looking to further expand the team to continue to increase our product portfolio. Those with strong analytical skills who are passionate about data and excited to scale quickly to deliver top-tier products to our clients are encouraged to apply. At Yipit Data, we value ownership and impact. Your growth is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at Yipit Data is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. Our career ladder also rewards strong performance with regular opportunities for compensation increases and promotions. See this short videoto learn more about our organization, product, and why some of our current data team members love working here!As a Data Associate, you will: Own high-impact data products end-to-end— driving product success by delivering best-in-class outputs with a focus on accuracy, client value, and efficiency. You’ll ramp quickly into full ownership of your products and workflows, operating with minimal oversight. Work with massive amounts of datato answer our clients’ key questions about the companies and datasets we analyze. You’ll develop deep expertise in our proprietary methods and techniques, building strong mental models that allow you to ensure data accuracy, identify methodology gaps, and derive key insights. Tackle complex data problems independently , using strong analytical judgment to refine methodologies, test new datasets, and solve challenges that require innovative thinking — even when information is incomplete or ambiguous. Use AI and tooling to drive meaningful leverage— significantly increasing speed, reducing manual work, and beginning to automate portions of workflows. You’ll standardize best practices and build repeatable processes, always maintaining a high bar for correctness and quality while validating AI-generated outputs. Collaborate cross-functionally with Research, Engineering, and other teams— coordinating across functions to unblock work, align on best practices, and develop technical solutions that streamline workflows, optimize data processes, and push the boundaries of automation. Identify and drive improvements to products and data pipelines , contributing ideas for new products, enhancements, and features. This could include developing new methodologies, exploring and scaling the use of new third-party datasets, or improving product profitability — all with a clear understanding of what drives value for clients.You Are Likely To Succeed If: You have 4–5+ years of experience in data, business, or predictive analytics and are proficient in SQL, Python, and Py Spark You have a proven track record of quickly learning new concepts, particularly complex data methodologies, and building strong mental models of how and why data works You actively use AI tools (e.g., Chat GPT, Copilot, or similar) to accelerate your work and are excited about using AI to drive leverage — not just productivity, but fundamentally better and faster ways of working You can clearly communicate complex concepts — including methodology, risks, and tradeoffs — both orally and in writing You have a strong ownership mentality and are enthusiastic about making a big impact at a rapidly growing company You can manage multiple projects simultaneously, independently prioritize tasks, and make sound decisions with incomplete information You have experience using sample or panel data to make precise estimates that guide decision-making You have a background in financial markets or are interested in learning more about data-driven investing You have an Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher)For You: Flexible PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) Flexible work schedule Personal laptop Health and wellness package Remote workWe are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Project manager
description:
Confira a vaga para Project manager em rio branco. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Ten16 Creative is looking for a mid-level Project Manager based in Brazil to help keep our creative work clear, organized, and moving forward. Ten16 is a creative partner for technology-driven companies, helping teams turn complex products into clear, market-ready brand, campaign, design, web, video, and motion experiences. Our clients operate across areas such as AI, Saa S, gaming, entertainment, consumer electronics, connected hardware, and B2 B technology.This is a remote contractor position for someone who is experienced enough to manage multiple moving pieces with confidence, but still hands-on, adaptable, and eager to grow with a fast-moving creative team. The right person will bring structure to creative work without slowing it down. They will help coordinate timelines, deliverables, client communication, internal reviews, production details, and day-to-day follow-through across projects that often involve strategy, design, writing, motion, video, web, and campaign development.About Ten16 Creative Ten16 Creative is a global creative studio with roots in the United States and São Paulo. We help tech-driven companies make complex products easier to understand, trust, and bring to market. Our work spans brand identity, campaign development, design systems, web design, presentations, marketing assets, video, motion, 3 D animation, AI-powered production, and creative leadership.We work with companies that need a creative partner who can bring clarity, consistency, and structure to sophisticated products. Our clients have included technology, AI, Saa S, gaming, entertainment, and consumer electronics brands, with representative work across companies and projects in various tech-driven spaces.About the Role The Project Manager will be responsible for helping Ten16 plan, coordinate, and deliver creative projects from kickoff through final delivery. This person will work closely with creative directors, designers, producers, writers, motion teams, developers, and clients to make sure everyone understands what needs to happen, when it needs to happen, and what is required to deliver excellent work.This role is ideal for someone who has already worked in an agency, creative studio, production company, marketing team, or digital product environment and understands how creative work moves from brief to execution. The role does not require senior-level account leadership, but it does require organization, fluent English and Portuguese communication skills, and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.You will manage active project timelines and ensure that milestones, deliverables, meetings, and reviews are clearly documented and communicated. You will help turn creative scopes into practical schedules, making sure that internal team members understand priorities and that clients understand what is needed from them to keep projects moving.You will coordinate daily and weekly project activity across brand, design, web, video, motion, campaign, and presentation work. This includes assigning or tracking tasks, following up on open items, preparing meeting agendas, documenting decisions, and making sure feedback is captured accurately. You will also help maintain project management tools, shared folders, project boards, calendars, and production documents so the team always has a reliable source of truth.You will support client-facing communication in English with professionalism and clarity. This may include sending status updates, recapping meetings, organizing feedback, preparing for presentations, and helping the team stay ahead of deadlines. Because Ten16 works with technology-driven companies, you should be comfortable working on projects where the subject matter may be complex, technical, or still evolving.You will help protect the quality of the work by making sure deliverables are complete, organized, properly labeled, and ready for review or delivery. You will not be expected to creative-direct the work, but you should have a strong eye for detail and enough creative production experience to recognize when something is missing, unclear, or not ready to send.Qualifications The ideal candidate has approximately 3–5 years of experience in project management, creative production, account coordination, marketing operations, agency operations, or a related role. They should have experience managing creative deliverables and coordinating cross-functional teams in a remote environment.
